description: This PHP source file defines the 'Node' class implementing a nested set model for hierarchical data management. It provides methods for managing tree structures, such as inserting nodes, retrieving parents and children, and deleting nodes, using Doctrine ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\ORM\NestedSet\Node
classes.description: Represents a node in a nested set hierarchy, providing methods for hierarchical data manipulation such as inserting, deleting, and traversing parent/child relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Node with a specified NestedSetInterface entity.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the underlying NestedSetInterface entity associated with this node.

methods.name: getLeftValue
methods.description: Retrieves the left boundary value of this node in the nested set.

methods.name: getRightValue
methods.description: Retrieves the right boundary value of this node.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Checks whether this node has child nodes.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Fetches child nodes up to a specified depth.

methods.name: hasParent
methods.description: Determines if this node has a parent node.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent node of this node, if any.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the depth level of this node in the hierarchy.

methods.name: insertAsLastChildOf
methods.description: Inserts this node as the last child of the specified parent node.

methods.name: shiftRlValues
methods.description: Shifts left and right boundary values starting from a specified position.

methods.name: persistNode
methods.description: Persists the node's boundary values to the database.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to this node.

methods.name: isLeaf
methods.description: Checks if the node is a leaf (has no children).

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the node is the root of the hierarchy.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes this node and its descendants from the hierarchy.
